title: Every serialized-scorer entry point must run _validate_serialized_scorer_payload, including after store fetch
answers: which handlers check scorer payloads for decorator call_source and destination kwargs
scorer registered before the check still runs through invoke
add a new endpoint that accepts serialized_scorer
why validate stored scorers as well as inline payloads
body:
Invariant: any handler that accepts a serialized scorer must call mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_serialized_scorer_payload, which enforces the call_source rejection and then _validate_third_party_scorer_data.
Enforced by: _register_scorer, _invoke_scorer_handler (on the inline payload and again after tracking_store.get_scorer replaces it), and _invoke_genai_evaluate_handler (on every scorer after registered versions are resolved and before create_run).
What breaks if skipped: rows written before these checks existed can carry call_source or api_base and would be deserialized and run by the scorer job or online scoring.
Constraints: validate the final payload, not only the request body; the check must run before Scorer.model_validate_json and before submit_job.
applies: Any new or edited handler under the scorer register, scorer invoke, or genai evaluate routes that reconstructs a Scorer from serialized data.
says: Previously saved evaluators run without passing security checks when triggered from storage.
Ensure stored custom scorers undergo security validation before executing in evaluation jobs.
Older registered judges bypass target endpoint validation during online scoring runs.
Block evaluators containing forbidden destination settings upon registration and invocation.
Saved evaluation metrics execute unsafe external source calls during model evaluation.
search: Any handler accepting a serialized scorer must call mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_serialized_scorer_payload to reject call_source and run _validate_third_party_scorer_data. It is enforced across _register_scorer, _invoke_scorer_handler on inline payloads and after tracking_store.get_scorer fetch, and _invoke_genai_evaluate_handler after resolving registered versions and before create_run. This prevents legacy stored rows containing call_source or api_base from executing in scorer jobs or online scoring. Validation must check the final payload before Scorer.model_validate_json and submit_job, applying to new or edited routes under scorer register, scorer invoke, or genai evaluate.
